about_the_game:
IN DIMAKERUS, EVERY PLAYER IS THE IMPOSTOR

Climb the social ladder by disguising as ANY character you kill to gain access to new areas, but you are going to have to put up an impression to deceive the other players who can also be hiding in plain sight as disguised guards, woodcutters, farmers or even statues!

MULTIPLAYER SOCIAL STEALTH (It is all about bluffing)

Behave as an NPC by walking and gesturing like one through the Emote System, and be mindful for NPCs acting suspiciously, for they may be players trying to hunt you down! 

DELVE INTO THE EARTHED RUINS OF ROME!

The areas you explore are more than what you expect: beneath the decaying roman ruins of the dark ages, there may be subterranean wonders of ancient enginery, shrouded in mysteries, as well as beings better left alone...

DYNAMIC COMBAT

In the ancient times, one had to survive by any means. Embrace the multiple ways of combat, such as sharp slashes and blunt strikes, finishing, and weapon-throwing mechanics... and a huge amount of fire!

As the enemies have as much chance to succeed as you, make use of a huge arsenal of deadly gear, varying from slicing blades such as sickles and gladius to crude maces and gigantic halberds, as you shed the blood of your enemies on the sands.

ALL ROADS LEAD TO ROME!

Explore different biomes from the inhospitable deserts of Africa, to the ravaged cities of Rome, reaching as far as the snowy northern lands! Each biome comes with different social and environmental changes the players are going to have to adapt to if they want to survive...

BURNT TO A CRISP...

Fire has changed the course of history. Use the devastating properties of this elementum combined with the environment to annihilate your foes and put into practice your combat pyromaniac strategies!

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains violence in pixel art style, including blood, gore, and dismemberment. Scenes of graphic combat are presented in a stylized, fast-paced retro aesthetic. Viewer discretion is advised.

short_description: Disguise as NPCs by taking their forms, mimic their behavior to deceive or prey on other players — who may also be disguised — as you steal as many goods as possible. Face NPC guards with a wide range of weapons and lots of uses to them. Unravel hidden procedural catacombs and its inhabitants.
